messages:
Aisha: quick FYI, we saw some odd behavior from low-bit runs in prod yesterday, want a short sync on tradeoffs and rollout approach
Miguel: saw the spike. On int8 we get noticeable p95 regressions on long-context summarization jobs
Aisha: numbers?
Miguel: on the long-doc QA set (>=1500 tokens): median latency -18% vs fp16, but p95 +12%. ROUGE-L down ~1.1 on abstractive summaries
Ken: 1.1 is significant. Is it uniform or a slice?
Miguel: concentrated on repetition-heavy inputs and cases where KV-cache is heavily reused (warm->cold churn)
Priya: observed fp8 variants occasionally change KV numeric stability; small alignment drift accumulates when cache reused across segments
Aisha: so basic tradeoff: cost/latency wins vs stability and long-context quality
Ken: my thought: treat these as "opt-in" profiles behind canaries and explicit opt-in headers, not default for customers
dev-bot: feature-flag update: precision_profiles toggled; canary rollout allowed at 2%
Aisha: what should gating/eval look like? current test suite focuses on short convs
Priya: add long-context holdouts (2k-4k tokens), repetition stress tests (token repeats, paraphrase loops), and cache warm/cold transition scenarios
Miguel: add metrics: slice-wise quality delta + operational safety checks. proposal: require ROUGE-L delta <= 0.5 and hallucination-rate delta <= 0.2 for canary to progress
Ken: also require p95 latency not worse than +10% and cost savings >15% to justify risk
Priya: safety roll triggers: any kv-cache error > 0, OOMs, or increase in token-dropout rate -> immediate rollback
Aisha: runtime API surface: do we want per-request precision override?
Priya: yes. propose header X-Precision-Profile: int8-econ (opt-in). default remains model_variant=fp16
Aisha: show a sample request + profile YAML for operators
Priya: paste

```yaml
precision_profile:
  id: int8-econ-v1
  ops_allowed: [matmul, attention]
  hardware_affinity:
    - hw: h100
      note: preferred
    - hw: a100
      note: validated-with-warnings
  fallback:
    on_qc_fail: fallback_to: fp16
    on_p95_regress: throttle: true
  canary:
    percentage: 2
    metrics: [p95_latency, rouge_l_delta, kv_error_count, hallucination_delta]
```

Miguel: also include a simple request example

```http
POST /v1/generate
Host: api.redwood.ai
X-API-Key: xxxxx
X-Precision-Profile: int8-econ-v1
{ "input": "<long document>" }
```

Ken: ops note: int8 kernels differ across hardware (A100 vs H100 vs Gaudi). we need a hardware matrix in profile metadata and per-hw canary configs
ops: will prepare a per-hardware canary plan, include memory/cpu/gpu telemetry hooks
Miguel: telemetry requirements: per-request precision tag, token-level timings (generation latency per token bucketed by seq position), fallback traces when fallback occurs
Aisha: rollout policy suggestion: 72h canary, must pass slice checks every 6h, auto-roll to next % if green, immediate rollback on any safety trigger
Ken: I'll draft a playbook with concrete alarm thresholds and rollback steps (ETA 3 days)
Miguel: I'll add the long-context slice to CI and create synthetic stress tests for repetition and cache-warm transitions (ETA 4 days)
Priya: I'll add header parsing and wire the precision tag into telemetry and logs; will also add server-side validation of profile/hardware affinity (ETA 1 week)
ops: will provide canary configs per GPU class and test fleet reservations (ETA 1 week)
dev-bot: reminder created: arch-sync agenda item "precision profiles canary/playbook" scheduled for Weds
Aisha: action items summarized above. please drop progress updates in this thread. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
